name: Miyauchi Akira
source:
A second-year student at Kayo Academy.
A promising young member of the karate club, she is Ibuki's best friend.

She has magnificent breasts that draw the eyes of the boys, but she is completely oblivious to them.

She is not aware that people are viewing her in a sexual way, so she unconsciously shows them off during practice.

Of course, she is unaware that Ibuki is looking at her with envy.
She has a weakness when it comes to being treated like a woman.
